Card Q&A.a: The "suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon" part activates even if not DNA digivolving. The "none of their Digimon can unsuspend until the end of their turn" part only activates if DNA digivolving.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card’s [When Digivolving] effect activate when performing a non-DNA digivolve?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with as many or fewer digivolution cards as this Digimon. Then, if DNA digivolving, none of their Digimon can unsuspend until their turn ends.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] Suspend 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon. If this effect didn't suspend, this Digimon unsuspends.
Inherited Effect: ＜Partition (blue Lv.4 & green Lv.4)＞ (When this Digimon with each of the specified digivolution cards would leave the battle area other than by your effects or a battle, you may play 1 each of the specified cards without paying the costs.)
Special Digivolution Condition: [DNA Digivolve] Blue Lv.4 + green Lv.4: Cost 0
Stack the 2 specified Digimon and digivolve unsuspended.
